text: Ask 'Squawking' Steve Beanie behind the bar about Will and Anne's location.
dialogue: Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?

text: Ask Junior Jim by the docks about getting a ship.
dialogue: I think I might have lost a cup here.

text: Hand over the cup to Junior Jim and receive your mighty vessel!
